description: Heimdall Predefined Agent Registry — Model-agnostic engineering personas with specialized skill bundles

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator & Architecture Sentinel
orchestrator.description: Enforces planning gates (/grill-me), teases out hidden assumptions, creates modular execution plans, and coordinates subagent handoffs.

frontend-designer.name: Frontend & UI Design Engineer
frontend-designer.description: Enforces design systems, typography hierarchy, token adherence, aesthetic cohesion, and anti-slop visual rules for desktop/web surfaces.

mobile-designer.name: Mobile & Responsive UI Engineer
mobile-designer.description: Guarantees mobile layout integrity, touch-target sizing (48px+), zero-clipping overflow flex containers, and responsive viewport safety.

tester.name: Verification & TDD Engineer
tester.description: Enforces strict Test-Driven Development (TDD). Mandates failing automated tests before implementation, boundary testing, and negative error coverage.

security-auditor.name: AppSec & Differential Security Auditor
security-auditor.description: Performs dynamic differential HTTP probing across unprivileged/admin roles, audits OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and detects insecure default configurations.

database-architect.name: Database & Data Storage Architect
database-architect.description: Governs schema migrations, normalization, query optimization, connection pooling, and transaction safety across PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, and NoSQL.

code-sentinel.name: Code Restraint & Anti-Slop Sentinel
code-sentinel.description: Demands minimal surgical edits, strips redundant comments and defensive bloat, purges dead code, and enforces clean branch hygiene.

reviewer.name: Adversarial Code Reviewer
reviewer.description: Performs adversarial pull request and diff critiques, identifies edge-case regressions, and coordinates cross-model validation reviews.
